top_signals.title: Treasury Yields Stay Elevated After First Post-Fed Economic Data
top_signals.summary: Long-term Treasury yields retained most of the surge unleashed by this week’s Federal Reserve rate decision after a raft of US economic data showed still-elevated inflation and labor-market resilience.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hyperscale Data sells 100 bitcoin to fund Michigan AI data center build
top_signals.summary: Hyperscale Data sold 100 bitcoin and opened a credit facility to fund its Michigan AI data center campus build.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
